context.title: A baseline before the rebuild
context.body: The target was https://vantflow.tech/ on the live pre-rebuild site. The crawl followed links from the homepage, so this is a narrow baseline, not a claim about future traffic, rankings, or outcomes.

steps.title: Crawl
steps.body: Run an OpenSEO site audit across the live same-origin footprint.

steps.title: Prioritize
steps.body: Separate observed issues from assumptions. Keep the list honest when the count is small.

steps.title: Fix
steps.body: Apply the rebuild and address the specific finding, without inventing a larger problem list.

steps.title: Verify
steps.body: Re-audit the site and compare the result with the baseline evidence.

findings.title: One information issue, three pages crawled
findings.intro: OpenSEO crawled three URLs. All returned HTTP 200. One info-level issue was flagged.

issue.title: Homepage title exceeds the preferred length
issue.body: Finding: the homepage title was “VANTFLOW | Automation Systems for Agencies and Property Teams”. The issue is limited to title length; no critical issue is claimed here.
issue.evidence: Before → fix: long homepage title → shorten while preserving the page’s meaning, then re-audit.

findings.scopeNote: Crawled: /, /privacy.html, /terms.html. Only three URLs were discovered from the homepage; services and proof pages were not part of that live footprint yet.

next.title: Expand the footprint, then check the work
next.body: The rebuild expands the information architecture beyond the three discovered URLs. The next useful step is to publish the intended pages, correct the homepage title, and run the same crawl again.
next.verify: Verification means checking the new crawl’s URL coverage, HTTP status, title output, and any remaining issue categories against this baseline.

cta.title: Book the audit and get a fix list you can verify
